mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) by more than 0.5% within a month signals a tightening monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investors anticipate reduced economic activity and corporate earnings.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in more than 40% of the triggered instances, or if the correlation between FEDFUNDS increases and negative 20-day returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) indicates weakening consumer demand, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as companies report lower earnings.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of the triggered instances, or if the correlation between RSAFS declines and negative 60-day returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% within a month signals a weakening labor market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as investors react to the negative economic signal.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of the triggered instances, or if the correlation between UNRATE increases and negative 5-day returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in industrial production (INDPRO) signals a strengthening supply side of the economy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as companies benefit from increased production and sales.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in more than 40% of the triggered instances, or if the correlation between INDPRO increases and positive 20-day returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) signals disinflationary pressure, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investors anticipate a more accommodative monetary policy.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in more than 40% of the triggered instances, or if the correlation between CPIAUCSL declines and positive 20-day returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in housing starts (HOUST) by more than 5% within a month signals a strengthening demand in the housing market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as the broader economy benefits from increased construction activity.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in more than 40% of the triggered instances, or if the correlation between HOUST increases and positive 20-day returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A joint increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) and a decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a strengthening labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as consumer spending and corporate earnings improve.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increases and UNRATE decreases simultaneously
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces negative 60-day returns in more than 40% of the triggered instances, or if the joint effect of PAYEMS increases and UNRATE decreases on positive 60-day returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in real GDP (GDPC1) signals a strengthening economy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as companies benefit from increased economic activity and higher earnings.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces negative 60-day returns in more than 40% of the instances following GDPC1 increases, or if the correlation between GDPC1 increases and positive 60-day returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).
